P1 (descriptive: can R_A at SAE latents.rule: gap = min over E245's 15 key items read of R_A (tol 0.1, all of D) - max over the 15 random_<state> items read of R_A (tol 0.1). Report gap against E245's band (0.1096, summary_built.json): gap > band: rival a (R_A at SAE latents reads key-task fine-tunes above random updates of their size, so its near-1 readings carry information); gap <= 0: rival b (a random update of key-task size also reads near 1: the SAE's remainders and per-latent gains absorb any update of this size, and E245's key readings carry no information about reuse); 0 < gap <= band: no call. Also per state, R_A(key item) - R_A(random_<state>), and the count of states with a positive difference.
